prompt:

Asset type: single transparent tutorial pointing-hand icon for a colorful mobile game UI.
Primary request: Exactly one soft puffy WHITE CARTOON GLOVE HAND, isolated. A right hand wearing a clean white four-finger mascot glove: index finger extended diagonally downward-right, other fingers loosely curled together, thumb clearly readable on the left side, short open rounded cuff at upper-left. The index fingertip is the lowest-rightmost point. Friendly polished 3D mobile game tutorial art with smooth simple padded shapes, subtle pale-gray form shading, thin dark-gray outline around silhouette, no human skin. Slight three-quarter view like a classic touch tutorial pointer. The hand alone, no forearm.
Composition: centered square image, entire wrist cuff and fingertip inside frame, 10 percent clear margin. True transparent alpha background.
Lighting: soft frontal studio light, white volume readable. No ground, cast shadow, yellow glow, aura or drop shadow; those are separate UI effects.
Constraints: exactly one hand and no duplicate gestures; no symbols, arrow, cursor, text, logo, interface panel, gradient backdrop or scenery. Transparent outside silhouette. Crisp silhouette that stays readable when reduced to 100 pixels.
slice: fixed; full image; no sourceCrop; native rotation per screen
note: No baked yellow glow or external shadow. Reference tutorial glow/rotation is native UI responsibility.
